name: hh-meanrev-micro: RSI capitulation bounce, liquid majors (1h fee-realist)
rationale: MECHANISM: the 1h fee-realist extreme of the capitulation-bounce cut — an RSI deep-oversold print on the hourly bar marks a larger, more considered seller-exhaustion, and the resulting bounce is big enough that fees are a small fraction of the move even on venues where 5m/15m bounces do not clear cost. The behavioral mechanism is unchanged (fear-selling clusters, bid ladder lifts price to VWAP); only the bar is slower, so the signal-to-cost ratio is highest here. Entry: rsi oversold AND bb_z confirming the extreme. Long-only spot; exit as rsi recovers. DISCONFIRMER: at 1h the sample thins fast — if effective-N collapses so the DSR/FDR gate rejects it, treat that as a kill, not a tuning target. Head-to-head with the 15m/30m variants: if 1h does not have the best net-of-fee Sharpe, the extra cost headroom bought nothing over faster bars — keep the winner. Must still beat buy-and-hold on majors or the bounce was smaller than the interrupted trend.
catalyst: RSI capitulation bounce on majors, hourly bar for maximum cost headroom
